title: crypto2dev CI: RHEL-family distro matrix (Rocky, Fedora, AL2023)
description: Run TEST_CRYPTO2DEV=1 TEST_LINUXKM=1 ./tests/ci/test-on-aws.sh for Rocky Linux 9, Fedora latest, and Amazon Linux 2023. These use DNF and have different kernel-devel alignment requirements. Rocky 9 is the primary enterprise Linux target. Track any distro-specific build failures (kernel header paths, missing packages, vermagic mismatches) and fix them in the script or shim Makefile.
notes: Fedora sign-file fix: ldd check + recompile from source. wolfkm crypto2dev_fd.c:2045 op.provider bug fixed. Re-runs launched (v2).
